overview.en: Euproctis similis, the Yellow-tail, is a tussock moth in the family Erebidae; its French common name is Cul-doré.
overview.fr: Euproctis similis, le Cul-doré, est un papillon de la famille des Erebidae, parmi les bombyx à houppes.

identification.en: The adult has a 28–35 mm wingspan; females are larger and carry a conspicuous yellow hair tuft at the abdomen tip.
identification.fr: L’adulte a une envergure de 28 à 35 mm ; la femelle, plus grande, porte une touffe de poils jaunes à l’extrémité de l’abdomen.

habitat.en: Its caterpillars feed on deciduous trees and shrubs, with French field records including willow and poplar.
habitat.fr: Ses chenilles consomment des arbres et arbustes feuillus ; des observations françaises les signalent notamment sur saule et peuplier.

diet.en: The caterpillars feed on deciduous woody plants; sources list several trees and shrubs rather than one exclusive host.
diet.fr: Les chenilles mangent des ligneux feuillus ; les sources indiquent plusieurs arbres et arbustes plutôt qu’une plante-hôte exclusive.

behavior.en: Larvae bear irritating hairs and should not be handled; the female uses her yellow abdominal tuft to cover newly laid eggs.
behavior.fr: Les chenilles portent des poils irritants et ne doivent pas être manipulées ; la femelle recouvre ses œufs fraîchement pondus avec sa touffe abdominale jaune.

reproduction.en: It has one generation each year and overwinters as a solitary third-instar larva. Pupation occurs in foliage.
reproduction.fr: Elle produit une génération par an et hiverne seule au troisième stade larvaire. La nymphose a lieu dans le feuillage.

ecology.en: It resembles the Brown-tail, Euproctis chrysorrhoea, and has a similar life cycle, but its larvae are solitary rather than gregarious; see that related profile.
ecology.fr: Elle ressemble au Cul-brun, Euproctis chrysorrhoea, et son cycle est similaire, mais ses chenilles sont solitaires et non grégaires ; voir sa fiche.

conservation.en: The consulted regional accounts document its occurrence but do not provide a current global conservation assessment.
conservation.fr: Les sources régionales consultées documentent sa présence, mais ne donnent pas d’évaluation mondiale actuelle de son état de conservation.

facts: UKMoths reports adult size, female tuft, flight period, larval host range and irritating hairs.
Anses describes its one-generation life cycle, overwintering stage, solitary larvae and relationship to E. chrysorrhoea.
French regional page gives the common name and reports pupation in host foliage.

uncertainties: Regional range records are not a substitute for a global conservation category; the name Sphrageidus similis is also used as a taxonomic combination.
review_note: Comparison with Euproctis chrysorrhoea is based on the French Anses report; the cross-reference is reciprocal where that profile exists.
